blocks.text: For more on the sacred falcon see Aldrovandi, Ornithol. vol. 1, book 7, ch. 2, p. 467 ff. Compare Reliqua librorum Friderici II. Imperatoris de arte venandi cum avibus book 2, ch. 22, p. 84, ed. Schneider, and Albertus Magnus, de falconibus, ch. 5, p. 178 in the cited book; with these should be joined J. G. Schneider's Commentarii vol. 2, pp. 90, 109, 185 f.
